remarks: Welcome to 67 Breezewood Dr. Beautifully appointed home with over 5000 sq. ft. of luxury open concept living. This home was a former model home. Impressive 2 story foyer, elegant finishes throughout. A french door opens to the den with hardwood floor, & built-in shelving. Living room features hardwood flooring, & crown molding. Hardwood floors continues into the formal dining room that features a trey ceiling & wainscoting. Gourmet kitchen with oversized island, granite counters, a W/I pantry, tile flooring & includes all the appliances. First floor laundry with washer & dryer.  A bright sunroom with cathedral ceiling and wall of windows off the kitchen. Relax in the spacious great room with luxury laminate flooring, & a gas fireplace. Dual staircases. The 2nd floor offers 4 bedrooms. Double doors open to the master bedroom suite, trey ceiling, two walk in closets. An adjoining sitting room is off the master bedroom. The master bath offers 2 vanities, a tiled walk-in shower, and jacuzzi tub. Wait until you see the superb finished basement. There is 1200 sq. ft of additional living space in the beautiful, finished basement. 2 additional bedrooms, W/I closets, tile floors. Full bath with tiled shower. Large 2nd family room. Enjoy the maintenance free deck, and great yard. In ground irrigation system.  Side load 3 car garage is currently finished with hardwood flooring, recessed lights, and adds 300 sq. ft. more living area or can be converted back to a garage. Top rated Orchard Park schools (S. Davis elementary} Minutes to the villages of Orchard Park & East Aurora. A must-see home! Move in ready.
